track_id_reliability.note: IDs >= 9990 are ByteTrack fallbacks. Events with fallback IDs reflect valid spatial detections but lack confirmed trajectory identity.

scientific_statement:
Baseline — Pre-Intervention CCTV Segment
Across 426 analyzed frames (14.2 seconds), the system recorded a minimum interaction distance of 0.82 m and classified 0 interaction(s) as near-miss incidents under the V0.8 event-detection rules. A total of 5 unique frames were identified as occurring within defined caution/danger risk zones, corresponding to 1.17% of analyzed frames.

Metric distance is derived from the current warehouse CCTV ground-plane perspective model and planar homography reference. The 0.82 m value should be treated as a calibrated system estimate rather than an independently validated physical measurement until camera calibration is verified against known ground distances.

Approach speed and TTC are currently calculated in image space; therefore, TTC should be interpreted as a screen-space temporal risk proxy (ttc_image_proxy_sec), not yet as a physically calibrated time-to-collision measurement.

This baseline is suitable for before/after comparative analysis within the same calibrated camera setup, subject to validation of object tracking, identity continuity, and metric calibration.
calibration_model: Warehouse CCTV Ground-Plane Perspective Model + 4-pt Planar Homography
ttc_note: ttc_image_proxy_sec = distance_px / approach_speed_px_s. Unit is seconds in image-space, not physical TTC.
status: Risk Baseline Established (Ready for Safety Backfire Comparison — Experimental)
